subject: Temporary invoice-only lane for ClearRoute Labs pilot
messages:
From: Elaine Park <elaine@clearroute.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tim Hollis <tim@clearroute.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: pilot onboarding without PO for ClearRoute Labs

Hi Vanessa —

Thanks for the chat earlier. ClearRoute would like to run a 60-day pilot (integration + 2 months of usage) with Redwood Inference. Estimated spend for the pilot is small: ~USD 3,500 per month. Our accounting team prefers invoicing rather than issuing a PO for pilots under $5k/month to avoid delays.

Attached: ClearRoute_SOW.pdf (1 page summary) and ClearRoute_W9.pdf. Can Redwood temporarily onboard us on an invoice-only basis? We can agree to standard payment terms (Net 30) and provide any evidence you need (SOC2 report, primary contact for security questionnaire).

Next steps from our side:
- If accepted, I can sign a short pilot statement of work and send invoices to finance@clearroute.com (we can CC your billing alias).
- Happy to share SOC2 Type II and references.

Appreciate a quick answer — we want to start the integration week of Apr 2.

—Elaine
Director of Partnerships, ClearRoute Labs

Attachments: ClearRoute_SOW.pdf, ClearRoute_W9.pdf
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Procurement Team <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Mar 2028 10:35:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: pilot onboarding without PO for ClearRoute Labs

Karthik / Naomi —

Forwarding a request from ClearRoute (external). Pilot looks low-touch and time-sensitive (integration week of Apr 2). Value: potentially a product-led reference in logistics space; small initial spend (~3.5k/mo).

Proposed ask: grant a 90-day temporary invoice-only onboarding lane tied to these conditions:
- Max invoice exposure capped at USD 10k for the pilot period
- Finance must receive invoices to billing@clearroute.com and be CC'd to billing@redwood.ai
- ClearRoute provides SOC2 Type II and W9 before first invoice
- Procurement will re-evaluate at day 75 and require standard PO process for ongoing usage

If we can get conditional signoff I will confirm to the vendor and request the SOC2 and W9.

Thoughts?

—Vanessa
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Mar 2028 08:50:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: pilot onboarding without PO for ClearRoute Labs

Vanessa — thanks for the clear summary. Procurement is open to a temporary invoice-only path for low-dollar pilots but we need strict controls. Please see procurement conditions below and confirm acceptance from the vendor: 

Procurement conditional approval (subject to receiving attachments/evidence):
1) SOC2 Type II or equivalent security attestation received and reviewed by Security (Naomi).
2) W-9 on file (received).
3) Invoices limited to Net 30, with a single rolling cap of USD 10,000 (procurement will block invoices beyond the cap until PO is issued).
4) This exception is time-limited to 90 days from onboarding date. After 75 days procurement will reach out to convert to standard PO (or escalate to finance/legal for approval).
5) Legal to review SOW for terms that could create long-term commitments (Marissa to help).
6) Procurement exception form must be completed and attached to vendor record — I have attached procurement_exception_form.docx (stub).

If vendor accepts these conditions we can proceed. Naomi — can you confirm SOC2 review timeline? Marissa — can you flag any legal risk in SOW?

-Karthik
Director, Procurement

Attachments: procurement_exception_form.docx
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Park <elaine@clearroute.com>
Cc: Tim Hollis <tim@clearroute.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 25 Mar 2028 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: pilot onboarding without PO for ClearRoute Labs

Hi Elaine —

Thanks — good news. Procurement can approve a temporary invoice-only onboarding lane for ClearRoute’s 60-day pilot under the following conditional terms (please confirm in reply):

- ClearRoute provides SOC2 Type II report and the W-9 before we process the first invoice.
- Invoices will be Net 30; Redwood will accept invoices up to a rolling cap of USD 10,000 for the pilot period. Any invoiced amount beyond that cap will be held until a PO is issued.
- The exception is granted for 90 days from the onboarding date. Procurement will contact you at day 75 to transition to the standard PO flow for ongoing usage.
- We need a signed pilot SOW confirming there are no auto-renewals or long-term commitments.

If you confirm acceptance I will: 1) complete the procurement_exception_form and attach to your vendor record, 2) kick off legal review with Marissa, and 3) notify billing to expect the first invoice.

Looking forward — can you confirm SOC2 and sign SOW by Mar 29 so we can onboard the week of Apr 2?

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
